Author: @ibrahimmoss
Content:
Sir Marques:

Thanks for a banner year in 2024. I loved just about everything you posted.

Just a word of caution. Beware of arrogance.  It can be a blind spot.  You are of a privileged class / culture, but never believe yourself to be like your other employees / talent.  You may not see it, but it is likely the explanation for things like the way too critical reviews of the Ocean.  You should have known that the review would materially harm the auto maker.  Ditto the same thing about the Lambo acceleration testing on a public road. If you were unconscious of the effects of your actions, know that you should concentrate on your blind spot. 

Aspects of your broadcasts remain top notch, but I think you know that there are reviewers out there who are not just hungry, but also appealing to those who have your following nor numbers. 

If I were to make a recommendation to you, I would strongly encourage you to embrace DEI. I would use them in a manner that is different.  I would ask them to test products and share the same with your audience. The setting would be more like a home than a studio.  Include some smart techie women in the mix, and a few brown skin men like yourself who are distinguished by class and smarts. Sure, you’ll lose a few viewers at first. But, you’ll likely gain 3X what you enjoy now. 

Last, just as there are things like cars that you now review, start looking at other products as well.  After all, consumers dont just buy mobile phones, tablets and computers. 

Highest regards
